title: WeChat mini program driven through the DevTools automation endpoint

runtime.name: miniprogram-automator
runtime.installHint: npm i miniprogram-automator in a scratch directory outside the repo (the host project uses %TEMP%/mp-auto) and point MINIPROGRAM_AUTOMATOR_PATH or NODE_PATH at it

coordinates.derivation: el.offset() is document-space; page.scrollTop() is subtracted so the basis matches the web adapter. Screenshot scale is NOT 1 and is measured per capture
